CREATE DATABASE dbNullTest; CREATE TABLE dbNullTest.t1 (id INT NULL, name VARCHAR(20) NULL); SELECT TABLE_SCHEMA, TABLE_NAME, COLUMN_NAME, IS_NULLABLE FROM information_schema.COLUMNS WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = 'dbNullTest' AND (IS_NULLABLE = 'NO' OR IS_NULLABLE IS NULL); DROP TABLE dbNullTest.t1; DROP DATABASE dbNullTest;

CREATE DATABASE dbTypes CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_bin; CREATE TABLE dbTypes.t1 (id INT, d DECIMAL(10,2), dt DATETIME, b BLOB); CREATE TABLE dbTypes.t2 (id INT, f FLOAT, t TEXT, j JSON); SELECT TABLE_SCHEMA, TABLE_NAME, COLUMN_NAME, DATA_TYPE FROM information_schema.COLUMNS WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = 'dbTypes' AND (DATA_TYPE = 'INT' OR DATA_TYPE LIKE 'VAR%'); DROP TABLE dbTypes.t2; DROP TABLE dbTypes.t1; DROP DATABASE dbTypes;

CREATE DATABASE dbMulti CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_bin; CREATE TABLE dbMulti.m1 (id INT PRIMARY KEY); CREATE TABLE dbMulti.m2 (id INT PRIMARY KEY); CREATE TABLE dbMulti.m3 (id INT PRIMARY KEY); SELECT TABLE_SCHEMA, TABLE_NAME FROM information_schema.TABLES WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = 'dbMulti' AND (TABLE_NAME LIKE 'm1' OR TABLE_NAME LIKE 'm2%' OR TABLE_NAME LIKE '%3'); DROP TABLE dbMulti.m3; DROP TABLE dbMulti.m2; DROP TABLE dbMulti.m1; DROP DATABASE dbMulti;

CREATE DATABASE dbCaseSens CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_bin; CREATE TABLE dbCaseSens.Table1 (id INT); CREATE TABLE dbCaseSens.table1 (id INT); SELECT TABLE_SCHEMA, TABLE_NAME FROM information_schema.TABLES WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = 'dbCaseSens' AND (TABLE_NAME = 'Table1' OR TABLE_NAME = 'table1'); DROP TABLE dbCaseSens.Table1; DROP TABLE dbCaseSens.table1; DROP DATABASE dbCaseSens;

CREATE DATABASE dbEmpty CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_bin; CREATE TABLE dbEmpty.e1 (id INT); SELECT TABLE_SCHEMA, TABLE_NAME FROM information_schema.TABLES WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = 'dbEmpty' AND (TABLE_NAME IS NULL OR TABLE_NAME = ''); DROP TABLE dbEmpty.e1; DROP DATABASE dbEmpty;

CREATE DATABASE dbOrTest CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_bin; CREATE TABLE dbOrTest.t1 (id INT); CREATE TABLE dbOrTest.t2 (id INT); CREATE TABLE dbOrTest.t3 (id INT); SELECT TABLE_SCHEMA, TABLE_NAME FROM information_schema.TABLES WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = 'dbOrTest' AND (TABLE_NAME = 't1' OR TABLE_NAME = 't3' OR TABLE_NAME NOT IN ('t2')); DROP TABLE dbOrTest.t3; DROP TABLE dbOrTest.t2; DROP TABLE dbOrTest.t1; DROP DATABASE dbOrTest;
